The proper way to hold a chicken
That chicken is handling that thumb like a boss.

I know it's a joke but if you want to know the way to hold a chicken it goes like this.

I was in 4-h for 9 years and raised chickens and turkeys and you are actually supposed to hold a chicken like you would a football. The butt end will face outwards or to the side (depending on the situation) so they don't shit on you.

The head should face your bicep and your ring finger and pointer finger should hold their legs ,at the closest point to the bird's breast, close to prevent scratches when they inevitably freak out. You also have one side of the bird's wing pressed against your torso while your thumb holds the other wing down to prevent bruises to the underside of the wing.

An example of a bad hold notice how he is protecting the wings but the legs are not secured at all and that chicken if ill tempered will scratch the shit out of him and the kid will drop the chicken.

Proper way to hold a chicken, the second person has a better hold than the first wings are secure against the body on one side and the thumb holds down the other side of wings, the legs are secure and the showman is using his other hand to soothe the bird.

I can't see the third showman clearly but from what I can see the 3rd showman has the best hold, everything secure and tight without making the bird uncomfortable.
